stricker = df[df['player'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'steve stricker']
mickelson = df[df['player'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'phil mickelson']

stricker_country = stricker['country'].str.strip().str.lower().iloc[0]
stricker_score = stricker['score'].iloc[0]
mickelson_country = mickelson['country'].str.strip().str.lower().iloc[0]
mickelson_score = mickelson['score'].iloc[0]

def parse_score(s):
    import re
    nums = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'\d+', str(s))]
    return sum(nums)

# Claim: stricker is of scotland AND has lower score than mickelson of united states
country_ok = (stricker_country == 'scotland') and (mickelson_country == 'united states')
score_ok = parse_score(stricker_score) < parse_score(mickelson_score)

answer = bool(country_ok and score_ok)
